title: The quiet vowel /ə/
goal: Practise Schwa /ə/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: Relax your mouth for a short central vowel in an unstressed syllable. Do not give every syllable equal force. The vowel of a word can change when it is unstressed.
spelling: Different vowel letters can represent schwa. Stress helps you predict where a reduced vowel may occur.
task: Offer a banana. Make its middle syllable stronger than the other two.
story: A banana is on the sofa. May puts it on a plate.
